author: nottherealtar
install_msg: `/slots` to spin the café reels. `/slotsboard` for bragging rights. Tip points are fake — pride is real.
name: cafeslots
description: Interactive 3-reel café slot machine (bean, cup, croissant, golden latte). Spin button with animation, tip-point scores, and guild leaderboards. No real currency.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-member slot spin counts and payout scores in each guild.
